name: Even-Cycle Equivalence
statement: The even-cycle, connected two-regular bipartite, and dihedral mirror-graph descriptions define the same family.
proof: Every finite connected two-regular graph is a cycle, and bipartiteness makes its length even. The rank-two Coxeter arrangement of type $I_2(d)$ has $2d$ chambers cyclically adjacent, so its mirror graph is $C_{2d}$; conversely every $C_{2d}$ has this realization.
